verdict.rationale: The evidence only says the dashboard offers generic "detailed reports" and that dLocal handles "settlements". Nothing documents reconciling settlements to bank deposits, or reports itemizing fees, refunds, or chargebacks. Generic reporting and settlement features are adjacent capabilities, not the reconciliation capability this story asks for.

support.subject: As a finance-ops user, I can reconcile settlements to bank deposits with itemized reports covering fees, refunds, and chargebacks
